svg.title: Index Translator architecture
svg.desc: The web app runs in the browser. It picks the model by the text's length and keeps the history and any opened PDF there. Its requests go to one Bun process. A translation waits in its own line for the llama worker thread, which loads the chat model. Reading aloud waits in a second line for the speech worker thread, which loads the speech model, and the voice separator when a sample is uploaded. The two lines and the two worker threads never wait for each other. a translation: Web app → HTTP API → Translation line → llama worker. reading aloud: Web app → HTTP API → Speech line → speech worker.
